source.document: Kodak Professional Ektar 100 Film, publication E-4046, revised 2/16
source.credit: Eastman Kodak Company; original manufacturer measurements and graph content

ektar100-characteristic.conditions: Panel 'Characteristic Curves'. Exposure: Daylight. Process: C-41. Densitometry: Status M. Log H Ref = -0.84. Curves labelled B, G, R; sorted by maximum density.

ektar100-sensitivity.conditions: Panel 'Spectral-Sensitivity Curves'. Exposure: Daylight. Effective exposure: 1/25 second. Process: C-41. Densitometry: Status M, Density 0.2 > D-min. Traces label Yellow-, Magenta- and Cyan-forming layers, stroked in pieces; sorted by peak wavelength as b, g, r. Relative shape only. Four short shoulder strokes and a panel-top rule are detected and dropped by keeping the three longest traces.

ektar100-dye.conditions: Panel 'Spectral-Dye-Density Curves': Minimum Density (the orange mask) and Midscale Neutral, including typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min. Process: C-41. A colour negative plots no separate C/M/Y dyes, so this sheet's midscale-neutral-minus-D-min anchors a donor dye set.

film.name: *Kodak Ektar 100
film.base_density_note: Measured, not assumed: the sheet's D-min (Minimum Density) trace is the spectral base density, and what the Status M densitometer reads through it is subtracted from the characteristic curves.
film.channel_dmin_note: Per-channel minima are read off the characteristic curves and subtracted before unmixing, so the fitted dye amounts reach zero at full exposure.
film.sensitivity_note: PCHIP of the three plotted log-sensitivity traces; engine covers 380-780 nm, each trace is used only over its own plotted span and is unmeasured elsewhere. Relative shape only; the panel's Density 0.2 > D-min criterion is not an absolute speed.
film.density_tolerance_note: Gate on the unmixed dye amounts, not plotted density. 0.02 dye-amount units is about 0.8% of the 2.5-2.8 unit range used for the sibling preparations.
film.midgray_note: Measured: engine zero is placed where each layer reaches the density the densitometer reads through the sheet's own midscale-neutral (mid) trace.
film.antihalation_note: Not stated on the sheet. Taken from shipped kodak_ektar_100 (the same stock, upstream) rather than guessed; it drives the halation preset only.

print.note: The sheet names the Endura papers. Paired with Kodak's portrait-negative paper as a rendering choice.

sampling.method: Constrained positive normal-CDF mixture, four components per channel.

dye_donor.reason: Placeholder donor for the first run; the dye shapes are swept across shipped negatives and the best residual is chosen.

adaptation_donor.reason: Spectral adaptation parameters cannot be derived in this repository; borrowed from a shipped negative and recorded in the profile.

authorship: New source extraction, preparation recipe and profile prepared with Claude for this repository, 2026-11-05. Axis calibration derived from the page by scripts/bw_expansion/extract_graphs.py. Colour negative: dye shapes are a donor's, anchored against this sheet's own D-min and midscale-neutral traces.
